data.gender_notes: Aindrea is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Andros or Andreas means 'man' or 'manly'. The feminine form, Aindrea, could be interpreted as 'answerer of prayers' or 'manly woman'. The name Aindrea carries the meaning “Answerer of prayers” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aindrea usually hope their child will grow to embody answerer of prayers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies faith and strength, inspiring courage and humility.
data.etymology: Aindrea belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Answerer of prayers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aindrea total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אינדריאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אינדריאה הוא נגזר מהשם היווני אנδρέας, שפירושו גברי או חזק. באותיות עבריות, השם מתורגם לאינדריאה, ומשמעותו היא אשה חזקה ויפה, המושכת אליה גברים ואנשים ברוחניות.

in_greek.name: Αϊνδρέα
in_greek.meaning: Αϊνδρέα σημαίνει δυνατή και ωραία γυναίκα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αϊνδρέα είναι μια παραλλαγή του ελληνικού ονόματος Ανδρέας, που σημαίνει ανδρικός ή ισχυρός. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Ανδρέας συνδέεται με τον Απόστολο Ανδρέα, έναν από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού.

in_latin.name: Aindrea
in_latin.meaning: Aindrea means strong and beautiful woman
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Aindrea is derived from the Greek name Andreas, meaning manly or strong. In Latin tradition, the name Andrea is associated with strength and beauty, reflecting the virtues of the apostle Andrew, one of Jesus' twelve apostles.

in_english.name: Aindrea
in_english.meaning: Aindrea means strong and beautiful woman
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aindrea is a variant of the Greek name Andreas, meaning manly or strong. It is associated with the apostle Andrew, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, and reflects the virtues of strength, courage, and beauty. In Christian tradition, Aindrea symbolizes a strong and beautiful woman with a spiritual and courageous personality.

Aindrea could serve as a reminder to seek solace in prayer during challenging times and to trust in the divine response. Ultimately, the name Aindrea invites us to reflect on the power of faith and the strength of our own divine feminine spirits.
